derivation: Expectations are hand-written from the review CE text, the B1/B2/B3 fix lists, audit A1-A13 and the v1.1 documented contracts (docstrings 'malformed input yields INVALID with a code, never an exception', 'one encoding per value'). predictedOld is a separate pre-execution code-reading prediction for the ORIGINAL v1.1 bytes; it is never used as an expectation.

matching.all: no Python exception escapes; outcome equals; codesInclude subset of codes; codesExclude disjoint; codesAnyOf intersects; codesExactly equals sorted codes; labelsInclude subset; mustReport keys equal; stats keys equal; historicalWarningsInclude subset; for cli targets exitCode equals, stdout is exactly one JSON object and stderr contains no 'Traceback'
matching.invariants: never VERIFIED/ACCEPTED/PROOF_VERIFIED; bundle results proofVerification NOT_PERFORMED + ledgerAcceptance NOT_ESTABLISHED; admission results cryptographicVerification NOT_PERFORMED + ledgerAcceptance NOT_ESTABLISHED; qualification UNIT; catalogue sweep codes match ^CAT_; admission/bundle/context codes match ^(CTX|CAT|ADM|BND)_
matching.futureSchemaOnOld: cases with schemaGeneration=future are reported NOT_APPLICABLE_SCHEMA against the original v1.1; any observed outcome is kept as a raw observation and never implies a fix

ambiguities.AMB-1: Code naming: the pack requires the existing v1.1 code names (CTX_POLICY_SCHEMA, ADM_SCHEMA, ADM_CIRCUIT_CONSTANTS_SCHEMA, BND_STATEMENT_TYPE, BND_SCHEMA, BND_EVIDENCE_UPGRADE, ADM_AUDIT_DISPUTED, ADM_AUDIT_REQUIREMENT_UNMET, CAT_*). Renaming needs an amendment. Disposition: REQUIRED as written.
ambiguities.AMB-2: Per-case only the code that names the defect is required; other refusal codes may co-occur (e.g. a circuit-constant alias may also yield BND_ADMISSION_REFUSED). Disposition: codesInclude is minimal by design.
ambiguities.AMB-3: Informational document members (author, bundleRules, canonicalization, claimKindClasses, digestRules, schemas, settlementBoundary, settlementClassMapping) are not typed by v1.1. Disposition: pack REQUIRES CAT_DOC_SCHEMA for a non-container replacement (pack-derived from A7/A13, not a review CE); a fix author who disagrees files an amendment with an external reason and a fresh Opus security review.
ambiguities.AMB-4: Legacy policy/1 handling is decided, not ambiguous: policy/1 with accepted_auditors == [] stays valid (all legacy positive controls strict); non-empty legacy pairs are refused (CTX_POLICY_SCHEMA). The rejected alternative (keep scope-less pairs but give them zero credit) cannot refuse CE-3 dispute omission, because a pair carries no verdict.
ambiguities.AMB-5: Dispute matching: frozen only where unambiguous (key AND predicate match refuses; a dispute for a different key does not). A dispute naming the same key under a different predicate is NOT frozen.
ambiguities.AMB-6: Record over-claim beyond the consumer grant earns no credit; the pack does not require the over-claiming record itself to be refused when nothing else requires the missing scope.
ambiguities.AMB-7: B3-L7-CLI is an EXTENSION (review L7). Its failure is reported separately and does not decide B3 closure; it is still a contract defect (stdout must be one JSON object).
ambiguities.AMB-8: Synthetic successor/new rows (MCP-REF-11@1, MCP-REF-12@0, MCP-PLN-01@3 with own_ref) exist only in test worlds to reach catalogue-level typing and the OutRef type; they are not catalogue proposals. The genuine 143-row/89-head catalogue is unchanged.
